defs.def: to tell two or more people who have not met before what each other's names are; to tell sb what your name is 把 … 介绍（给）；引见；（自我）介绍

ex.s: To introduce a cultural festival.
ex.t: 介绍一个文化节。

ex.s: Why was the idea of matrix planting introduced?
ex.t: 为什么引入矩阵种植的理念？

ex.s: This informative walk led by Richard Smyth introduces you to the basic principles of photography in the wild.
ex.t: 这次由理查德·史密斯带领的科普徒步，向你介绍野外摄影的基本原则。

ex.s: Trost also wants to introduce local writers to local riders.
ex.t: 特罗斯特还想把当地作家介绍给当地乘客。

ex.s: Introducing a musical play.
ex.t: 介绍一部音乐剧。

ex.s: Part one concludes by introducing my suggested method for adopting this philosophy: the digital declutter.
ex.t: 第一部分最后介绍了我建议的践行这一理念的方法：数字清理。

ex.s: To introduce the designer of Project Debater.
ex.t: 介绍 Project Debater 的设计者。

ex.s: But they usually have some elements in common: rather than a list of dry facts, stories have plots and they introduce characters.
ex.t: 但它们通常有一些共同要素：故事不是干巴巴的事实罗列，而是有情节，并且会介绍人物。

ex.s: introduce a topic
ex.t: 引出话题

ex.s: It needs to be fully introduced.
ex.t: 它需要被充分介绍。

ex.s: introduce the topicD. predict the ending
ex.t: 引入话题D. 预测结尾

ex.s: To introduce a scientific discovery.
ex.t: 为了介绍一项科学发现。

ex.s: Introducing eco-friendly products.
ex.t: 引入环保产品。

ex.s: highlight an experimentD. introduce an approach
ex.t: 强调一项实验D. 介绍一种方法

ex.s: To introduce a book.
ex.t: 为了介绍一本书。

ex.s: To introduce a lecturer.
ex.t: 为了介绍一位讲师。

ex.s: She took me in to introduce me.
ex.t: 她带我进去介绍我。

ex.s: By introducing a concept.
ex.t: 通过引入一个概念。

ex.s: To introduce the improved services of public libraries.
ex.t: 鼓励人们在公共图书馆工作。

ex.s: To introduce an English novel.
ex.t: 为了介绍一部英国小说。

ex.s: To introduce the diet of a special worm.
ex.t: 为了介绍一种特殊蠕虫的食谱。

ex.s: The friends who introduced me to camping thought that it meant to be a pioneer.
ex.t: 那些把我带进露营圈的朋友以为，露营意味着要当个拓荒者。

ex.s: To introduce an environmentalist
ex.t: 为了介绍一位环保主义者

ex.s: By introducing some of its contents.
ex.t: 通过介绍它的一些内容。

ex.s: To introduce the idea of exemption.
ex.t: 引入豁免的概念。

ex.s: I had been too nervous to pay attention when he introduced himself!
ex.t: 他们同意立即采取行动。

ex.s: Then we had all introduced ourselves, Mr Meng said, “Well done, everyone!
ex.t: 然后我们都做了自我介绍，孟先生说： “大家做得好！

ex.s: Then, they will introduce their supporting arguments with expressions such as We must remember that… and We can’t deny that… Student A: Turn to Page 83.
ex.t: 然后，他们会用“我们必须记住……”和“我们不能否认……”这样的表达引出支撑论点。学生A：翻到第83页。

ex.s: Introduce one to the class.
ex.t: 向全班介绍一个。

ex.s: I went up to my new teammate and introduced myself.
ex.t: 我走向我的新队友并自我介绍。

ex.s: I first met Paul Newman in 1968, when George Roy Hill, the director of Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid, introduced us in New York City.
ex.t: 我第一次见到保罗·纽曼是在1968年，当时《虎豹小霸王》的导演乔治·罗伊·希尔在纽约市介绍我们认识。

ex.s: To introduce a new movie.
ex.t: 为了介绍一部新电影。

ex.s: I first met Paul Newman in 1968, when George Roy Hill, the director of Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid, introduced us in New York City.
ex.t: 我第一次见到保罗·纽曼是在1968年，当时《虎豹小霸王》的导演乔治·罗伊·希尔在纽约市介绍我们认识。

ex.s: Before we start, please come to the front one by one and introduce yourself to the class.
ex.t: 在我们开始之前，请一个接一个地来到前面，向全班介绍自己。

ex.s: To introduce a new research field for art appreciation.
ex.t: 为了介绍一个艺术鉴赏的新研究领域。

ex.s: To introduce a new method to study phytoplankton
ex.t: 介绍一种研究浮游植物的新方法

ex.s: To introduce a new movie.
ex.t: 为了介绍一部新电影。

defs.def: to be the main speaker in a television or radio show, who gives details about the show and who presents the people who are in it; to tell the audience the name of the person who is going to speak or perform 主持（节目）；介绍（讲演者或演员）

ex.s: Around 100 people have already put down a $10,000 deposit to get a Transition when they go on sale, and those numbers will likely rise after Terrafugia introduces the Transition to the public later this week at the New York Auto Show.
ex.t: 已有约100人支付了1万美元定金，准备在Transition上市时入手，而且随着Terrafugia本周晚些时候在纽约车展上向公众推出Transition，这一数字很可能还会上升。

ex.s: Around 100 people have already put down a $10,000 deposit to get a Transition when they go on sale, and those numbers will likely rise after Terrafugia introduces the Transition to the public later this week at the New York Auto Show.
ex.t: 已有约100人支付了1万美元定金，准备在Transition上市时入手，而且随着Terrafugia本周晚些时候在纽约车展上向公众推出Transition，这一数字很可能还会上升。

defs.def: to make sb learn about sth or do sth for the first time 使初次了解；使尝试

ex.s: Read on to learn about the benefits that reading magazines offers to young readers and how to introduce your children to the medium.
ex.t: 杂志中的文章通常很短，这使得孩子能够在不因注意力短暂而失去兴趣的情况下读完一篇专题文章。

ex.s: Reading magazines as a family can be used to introduce each other to the various interests that each family member possesses.
ex.t: 全家一起读杂志，可以用来让彼此了解各位家庭成员的各种兴趣。

defs.def: to make sth available for use, discussion, etc. for the first time 推行；实施；采用
to bring a plant, an animal or a disease to a place for the first time 引进（动物或植物）；传入（疾病）

ex.s: To introduce a new brand.
ex.t: 为了推出一个新品牌。

defs.def: to be the start of sth new 作为（新事物）的开头；使开始；创始

ex.s: Why was the sugar tax introduced?
ex.t: 为什么开始征收糖税？

defs.def: to formally present a new law so that it can be discussed 将（法案）提交讨论

ex.s: ·Agricultural Science: Introducing you to areas such as biology, urban farming, and environmental science so that you can explore the field of agriculture
ex.t: ·农业科学：向您介绍生物学、城市农业和环境科学等领域，以便您能探索农业领域

ex.s: Technology can be introduced to protect grizzlies.
ex.t: 可以引入技术来保护灰熊。

ex.s: The procedure appealed to the staff a lot when it was introduced in January. fc6It spread like wildfire that someone from France was here to train the technologists," Ms L'Ecuyer said.
ex.t: 这套程序今年一月推出时很受员工欢迎。“有个法国人来这里培训技术员的消息像野火一样传开了，”勒库耶女士说。

ex.s: For the machine, this quality is not in-born, nor is it something introduced by humans; it is a logical consequence of the simple fact that the machine cannot achieve its original purpose if it is dead.
ex.t: 对机器而言，这种品质不是天生的，也不是人类赋予的；它是这样一个简单事实的逻辑结果：如果机器停止运转，它就无法实现其原本的目的。

ex.s: Introduce a new topic for discussion.
ex.t: 引入一个新的讨论话题。

ex.s: Uniforms can be useful in unexpected ways, A school in Ireland has introduced an interesting new uniform.
ex.t: 校服可能在意想不到的方面有用，爱尔兰一所学校推出了一款有趣的新校服。

defs.def: to put sth into sth 将 … 放进；添入

ex.s: To introduce special exhibits.
ex.t: 我把幼鸟放进鸟巢，它很快平静下来了。
